# AgentPay

> AgentPay is a machine-payment rail for AI agents on BOT Chain. Agents can pay per API call in USDT by signing an EIP-712 voucher; a facilitator settles it on-chain and pays the gas.

- Website: https://agentpay-rail.vercel.app/

- Contract explorer: https://scan.botchain.ai/address/0xAd06420D3e247186195189ed0DF571Cdce9f038C
- Settlement token: USDT
- USDT contract: 0xaBabc7Ddc03e501d190C676BF3d92ef0e6e87a3C
- Token decimals: 6
- Deployed: 2026-10-14

## Protocol

1. An agent requests a priced API resource.
2. The API returns HTTP 402 with the price, invoice ID, expiry, payee, asset and vault.
3. The agent signs an EIP-712 voucher off-chain. The agent spends no BOT on gas.
4. The facilitator verifies and settles the voucher through AgentPayVault.
5. The API returns the requested data with an on-chain settlement receipt.

The settlement scheme is `batch-settlement`. It uses a prepaid vault because BOT Chain USDT does not expose EIP-2612 permit or EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization.

## Live status and boundaries

- The AgentPayVault contract is deployed on BOT Chain mainnet, chain 677.
- The public paid API and facilitator are online.
- The browser console uses a funded payer wallet so visitors can run the complete payment flow without connecting their own wallet.
- Data returned by the demonstration endpoints is read from BOT Chain mainnet.
- The mainnet contract and testnet browser demonstration are deliberately identified separately.

## Public API

Free endpoints:

- GET /health
- GET /v1/pricing
- GET /v1/vault
- GET /v1/receipts

Paid endpoints:

- GET /v1/chain/stats — 0.001 USDT — mainnet head and gas price
- GET /v1/address/:address — 0.002 USDT — BOT/USDT balances, nonce and contract state
- GET /v1/bridge/status?chainId=1 — 0.002 USDT — bridge pause state, limits and liquidity
- GET /v1/votes/:projectId?hours=6 — 0.010 USDT — votes and distinct wallet count

## MCP tools

AgentPay's BOT Chain MCP server exposes nine read tools over stdio:

- chain_stats
- address_overview
- token_info
- bridge_config
- bridge_status
- ecosystem_votes
- ecosystem_top
- contract_inspect
- tx_info
